_comment: Sessions in recordings/scene_2026-09-16_02-37-02_510e, named by their 4-character suffix.
Round 1 (06:38:27-06:40:33) trains; round 2 (06:41:01-06:43:36) is the held-out test, a
separate recording of the same five shapes in the same order. Val is taken from the tail of
the round-1 recording, since there is only one training session per class.
So the test score answers: does the model read the shape, or that particular recording?
